This document out lines the major maintenance 
 procedure P1, which must be performed for every five 
 years as indicated Y5 in the above title block.

This Pump is used to transfer the 
 coolant water to condenser for condensing the steam from turbine to condensate 
 water and also transfer water for closed cooling system.

The first draft initiated by eng. Yasser 
 soliman Rakha, tested by eng. Abed 
 Allah Ebrahiem, accepted by eng. 
 Mohamed Husseinand General Manager, 
 revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Abouda EL-Banna,
 and approved by eng: Fawzy Sobhy Ismail Abu 
 Sultan Power Station head sector.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman admin. and financial 
 inspection & quality control general director and supervisor of EDEPC 
 inspection and quality control head sector.

items:
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc

Isolated the circuit breaker of the pump 
 motor

Disconnect electric terminals of the Pump 
 Motor.

Isolate the Pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery valves.
Isolate cooling water for the pump.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid, Filler, 
 Feeler gauge,
Rags, Grease
Vibrometer, Dial indicator
Lifting equipment.

Measure Vibration 
 level for bearing and compare it with setting values then analyze it and 
 determine what to do

Check the discharge, 
 pressure of pump and compare it with the Setting values the replace the worm 
 components

Check the quantity, 
 pressure of cooling water for bearing of pump and compare it with setting 
 value,

And determine what to 
 do

The pump consists of a bowl assembly, column 
 assembly and discharge head assembly

Bowl assembly includes 
 the suction bell (086) the impeller case (077) the top case (076) the pump 
 shaft (167) and the impeller (176)

Column assembly implorers 
 the bottom column (422) the column bearing (383) the column shaft (400) and 
 the column shaft coupling.

Dismantle any auxiliary 
 piping and wiring that would interfere with disassembly

Check of alignment of 
 coupling

Dismantle pump half 
 coupling (530 ) from driver half coupling (529 )

Unscrew motor bolts and 
 take it out

Measure the pump 
 clearance and recorded it

Dismantle adjusting plate 
 (532 ), pump half coupling (530 ) and pump half coupling keys (676- 3)

Dismantle the main 
 discharge piping from discharge head (465) and put flange

Dismantle discharge head 
 (465) from foundation plate (429)

Lift the pump assembly a 
 few feet and support it by I -beams placed across the foundation opening to 
 catch

Dismantle the stuffing 
 box packing assembly (050)
The lifting lugs of the column

Thread lifting eye bolt into head shaft (404) and 
 attach lifting line with some slack

Attach separate lifting lines to lifting lugs of 
 discharge head (465) and disconnect discharge head from column (422) and lift 
 discharge head only ( not shaft ) straight up l or 2 feet and disconnect the 
 shaft coupling

Lower the discharge head monetarily to take up 
 slack in shaft lifting line.

Lift the discharge head and shaft clear of the 
 foundation

Remove any remaining shaft coupling parts from the 
 head shaft lower end

Place discharge head to rest on wood blocks and 
 disconnect its lifting lines
Lift the head shaft clear of the discharge head

Remove the remaining assembly from the pit. by 
 using column lifting lugs,

Place the assembly horizontally on suitable v- 
 block supports

Disconnect outer column (422) from top case (076) 
 and carefully remove the column along the shaft
Disconnect and remove coupling and column shaft
Place the pump bowl assembly in operating position

Resting the suction bell (086) on suitable wood 
 block supports

Dismantle the splitter 
 plate (630)

Detach and remove the top case (076) and lifting 
 the case squarely to avoid binding and possible bearing damage

Using a lifting eye bolt threaded into top end of 
 pump shaft (167)

Lift and remove pump shaft and attached impeller 
 from assembled impeller case (077) and suction bell (086)
Remove in sequence the socket head cap screws

Dismantle sand cap (244), split ring (256-1) , 
 impeller (176)and key (676-1)

Dismantle retaining screws and use back off screws 
 to free the parts
Dismantle the pump bearings and wear rings

Measure clearance of 
 all diametral running of the pump and compare it with the setting value (such 
 as suction bell bearing (104), top case bearing (397), column bearing (383), 
 stuffing box bushing (233), and wear ring).

Inspect all O-rings and 
 packing rings removed during disassembly for wearing.

Clean and wash all 
 contact parts and dry it using compressed air

Inspect each part for 
 wear, erosion or corrosion and replace it if it is needed.

Check the diametric 
 running clearance specification and replace all excessively worn part

Check all threads to 
 insure that there are no incompletely cut thread, burr or metallic slivers and 
 replace any bolting which does not pass visual inspection

Check the run out of 
 shaft and record it.

Check and measure 
 clearance of all diametric running of the pump

Install the pump bearing 
 and wear rings

Check that all retaining 
 screws are securely tightened

Install the impeller key 
 (676-1) in shaft key way

Slide the impeller into 
 shaft past split ring groove

Install split ring 
 (256-1) and slide impeller down to seat against the split ring

Install secure sand cap 
 (244) to the impeller using socket head cap screws with lock washers

Install suction bell 
 (086) and impeller case (077)

Install assembled suction 
 bell and impeller case in operating position on wood block supports

Using a lifting eye bolt 
 in pump shaft (167)

Install the assembled 
 pump shaft (167) and impeller into the assembled impeller case (077) suction 
 bell (086)

Install tops case (076) 
 over the pump shaft to mate with impeller case (077)

assemble the retaining 
 cap screws lock washers and nuts

Place the pump bowl 
 assembly horizontally as level as possible on wood block supports.

Grease suction bell 
 bearing (104) by removing pipe plug from suction bell bearing housing (grade2)

Change the position of 
 the pump bowl assembly from horizontal to vertical

Assemble inner column 
 connector (612) to pump top case

Place two inner column 
 -o-rings (747-1) into position on inner column connector (612)

Thread lifting eye bolt 
 into the tap and of column head shaft (400) and attach a lifting line

Lift the shaft (400) and 
 position it approximately two feet above the pump shaft (167)

Install coupling part and 
 assemble the column shaft (400) to the pump shaft (167)

Threaded up tightly by 
 the coupling nut (255)

Remove set screw (795) 
 and drill small holes in the shaft, on screw center line, large enough to dog 
 point.

Replace the set screw 
 tightly and peen to prevent loosening.

Attach lifting lines to 
 the lifting lugs of the bottom column (422)

Lift and position the 
 bottom column over the top of the column haft (400).

Align match marks and 
 slowly lower the column into the flange of the bowl assembly.

Assembly and torque the 
 retaining cap screws, lock washers and nuts.

Lift the pump bowl column 
 assembly, lower it into the foundation opening and support it by I beams 
 placed

Across the foundation 
 opening to catch the column lifting lugs.

Dismantle lifting 
 equipment.

Install column bearing 
 (383) and check the bearing retaining screws are securely tightened.

Install two inner column 
 -O- rings (747-1) into their grooves at the top end of the column.

Thread lifting eye bolts 
 into the top end of head shaft (404) and attach a lifting line.

Lift the head shaft (404) 
 and positions it two feet above the column shaft (400).

Install coupling parts 
 and assemble the head shaft to the column shaft

Drill small holes for 
 coupling set screws and peen the set screw to prevent loosing

Attach lifting lines to 
 the lifting lugs of the discharge head (465) lift and position it over the top 
 of the head shaft (404)

Check the mating flange 
 is clean and free of damage

Carefully lower the 
 discharge head (465) to mate with the column

Assemble and torque the 
 retaining cap screws, lock washers and nuts

Lift the pump assembly to 
 remove the supports

Check that top surface of 
 foundation plate (429) and bottom surface of discharge head outer flange are 
 clean and free damage

Lower the pump into 
 position at foundation plate (429) and secure with lock washers and stud nuts
Remove lifting equipment

Install the stuffing box 
 packing assembly (050)

Install the gland studs 
 nuts.

Measure the pump 
 clearance and recorded it.

Support the driver 
 vertically, shaft facing down and the thoroughly clean the shaft end meant 
 surfaces

Connect the main 
 discharge piping to the discharge head out put flange

Connect any auxiliary 
 piping, wiring and instruments

Install key in driver 
 shaft key way, press the driver half coupling all the way up on driver shaft

Insert split ring and 
 pull the drive half coupling down to set firmly against the split ring

Install key (s) in shaft, 
 Slide on pump haft coupling and thread on adjusting plate (532)

Install driver on pump 
 and temporarily tighten the mounting fasteners

Check the alignment of 
 coupling and record it.

Insert two of coupling 
 bolts and tighten progressively until secure

Thereby closing the gap 
 above the adjusting plate and raising the impeller (s) to running position

Insert the remaining 
 coupling bolts and tighten all bolts securing

Before 
The Starting the Pump the Fool Awing Steps Must Be Checked

items:
Open the cooling lines to 
 gland and the quantity of water is sufficient (8 10 GPM)

Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump

Check the level of the 
 sump

Priming of the pump by 
 filing the tunnel between pump and condenser by screen travel pump

Check the level of oil in 
 bearing of driver

Open the delivery valve gradually after the
 pump has been started to 
 operate at its full Speed.

Check the discharge, 
 pressure and vibration during operation

Check the temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge

Check the quantity and 
 pressure for cooling water

Check the leakage from 
 stuffing box
